- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?
Standardize configuration lifecycle ownership: section validation is parameterless and local; cross-section validation and derivation belong to the container.

- Move RNG/model derivation into the shared container, preserving legacy CLI/YAML model-adapter binding.
- Move scheduler/training/optimizer and RL/training/DDP relationships into zero-input container methods. Keep framework-owned `cfg.finalize()` once-only and preserve derivation order.
- Cross-config derivations are inline in container `_finalize()`. Finalization assigns derived values directly; on failure they may remain populated, but `_finalized` stays false. `validate()` remains read-only.
- Keep pre-container CLI validation at the parsing boundary, including inference-deployment checks that the training container cannot express yet.
- Logger/profiler already meet this lifecycle API contract and are unchanged. Pending CheckpointConfig #8558 is not pulled into this PR.
- Preserve config fields, checkpoint serialization, CLI behavior, and copyright years. This does not redesign existing constructor normalization.

### Validation

Pinned baseline: `581248531`. Local RTX 6000 Ada, existing NeMo `26.08.rc9` image, GPU-enabled `torch.distributed.run` (one rank).

- Focused lifecycle/RL/scheduler run: **152 passed**.
- Targeted RL utility offload/layout call-site tests: **2 passed**.
- Initial cleanup (`1e8c5163e`), expanded config, RNG, logger, profiler, scheduler, initialization and argument-adapter suites: candidate **727 passed / 4 failed**, baseline **726 passed / 4 failed**. All **728 common test IDs have identical outcomes and failure messages**.
- The four shared failures require SM90+ for DSv4; this GPU is SM89. No new failures.
- Two new behavioral cases check scheduler recipe edits with pure validation and rejection of a resolved RL batch without marking the container finalized. Existing behavior tests now call the container API; one deployment-only case remains covered through the CLI test instead of the removed section API.
- Black, isort, pinned Pylint 3.2.6, Ruff and syntax checks passed for the relevant changed files; `git diff --check` passed. The autoformat wrapper itself refuses host Git 2.25.1 (<2.31), so its checks were invoked directly.
- Independent full-diff review completed; the legacy non-TransformerConfig guard it identified was restored and re-reviewed.

No full training/convergence run is claimed.

- **Small updates (bug fixes, minor improvements)**: a linked issue is **recommended** and will accelerate the PR review process.

Related to #3554. Tracking: [MB-1916](https://linear.app/nvidia/issue/MB-1916/standardize-config-validation-and-finalization-ownership).

 copy to the file header:

No code copied from another repository; existing in-repository rules are relocated.

- Source URL, revision, and original file(s): N/A
- Files in this PR containing the copied or adapted code: N/A
- Applicable license(s): N/A
- Required copyright notices and attribution, and where they are retained or added: Existing notices unchanged.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel (Triton, `jit_fuser`/`torch.compile`, CUDA extension, TE or external-library dispatch, or a scatter/index accumulation), I have added or updated its bit-exact determinism test and registered it in `tests/unit_tests/determinism/kernels/manifest.py` ([guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/docs/developer/determinism/testing.md))
- [ ] I have added proper typing to my code [Typing guidelines](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html)
- [x] I have added relevant documentation
- [ ] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR

### Code review

Feel free to message or comment `@NVIDIA/mcore-oncall` to help accelerate your merge into main. The less complex your PR is, the faster it will be approved and merged!

All PRs start as **draft**. If you open a non-draft PR, it will be automatically converted to draft.
